newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end lower as funds flow in.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end lower as funds flow in.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates ended lower on Friday as persistent fund continued to flow to the banking system, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate finished at 5.900 percent against Thursday's 6.060 close, falling below the 6.00 percent support, with 30-day commercial paper at 5.40-5.50 against 5.60-5.65.
Further declines were expected amid loosening liquidity, dealers said.
In the bond market, the 10-year 86/4 bond yield was at 6.015-020 and the 15-year construction bond yield at 6.214.
